source.scope: These sources apply to the point forecast (tap the map). Map layers come from the model chosen below.
source.mapLayer.hint: Wind arrows and the colour field come from Open-Meteo — the only source that serves a grid rather than single points.
source.model.wave.hint: The wave model applies to wave layers only. Sea temperature, sea level and currents always come from the automatic choice — wave models do not compute those fields.
layer.rateLimited: Weather data cannot be updated — the Open-Meteo request limit has been reached; retrying in {min} min.
layer.showingCached: The map is showing the most recently fetched data.
layer.failed: Wind layer not updating — source not responding. The map shows the last data fetched.

route.noPoints: Add the first point from the map or your GPS position.
route.needTwoPoints: At least two points are required to finish the route.

route.auto.title: Automatic route
route.auto.subtitle: Safety before distance — depths, rocks, fairways and traffic schemes
route.auto.mapPickHint: Tap the map to place point {point}.
route.auto.searchPlaceholder: Search for a harbour or place…
route.auto.endpointOnlyHint: Automatic routing uses the first and last points of the current drawing; intermediate points are removed when the route is accepted.
route.auto.dimensionsRequired: Enter the vessel beam and height above water to calculate an automatic route.
route.auto.noRoute: No route was found for these endpoints and vessel dimensions.
route.auto.dataUnavailable: The routing data is not sufficiently available right now. Try again later.
route.auto.previewHint: This is a preview. The route is not saved until you accept it.
route.auto.acceptedHint: The automatic route is in use and weather analysis follows its actual geometry.
route.auto.snappedEndpoints: Moved to navigable water: A {start} m, B {end} m.
route.auto.unknownDistance: {distance} NM of the route crosses an area with incomplete source data.
route.auto.sourceWarning: At least one routing data layer is partial, missing or stale.
route.auto.reason.traffic_direction_unve: traffic-lane direction not verified for this leg
route.auto.issueCode.source_unavailable: A routing data source is unavailable.
route.auto.issueCode.source_partial: A routing data source has partial coverage.
route.auto.issueCode.source_stale: Stale cached routing data was used.
route.auto.issueCode.start_snapped: The start was moved to navigable water.
route.auto.issueCode.end_snapped: The destination was moved to navigable water.
route.auto.issueCode.search_timeout: Route search exceeded its time limit.
route.auto.issueCode.search_node_limit: Route search exceeded its computation limit.
route.auto.issueCode.endpoints_not_navig: Neither endpoint could be moved to navigable water within 1 NM.
route.auto.issueCode.start_not_navigable: The start could not be moved to navigable water within 1 NM.
route.auto.issueCode.end_not_navigable: The destination could not be moved to navigable water within 1 NM.
route.auto.issueCode.harbour_access_infe: A harbour-access corridor was derived from official fairway and navigation-aid data.
route.auto.issueCode.harbour_access_not_: The harbour entrance could not be connected safely to navigable water.
route.auto.issueCode.harbour_draught_lim: The vessel draught exceeds the harbour's published limit. The registry-based approach corridor was not used.
route.auto.issueCode.harbour_beam_limit: The vessel beam exceeds the harbour's published limit. The registry-based approach corridor was not used.
route.auto.harbourLimit.draught: Vessel draught ({actual} m) exceeds the published limit of {harbour} ({limit} m). The route ends in the nearest provable water; verify the harbour depth yourself.
route.auto.harbourLimit.beam: Vessel beam ({actual} m) exceeds the published limit of {harbour} ({limit} m). The route ends in the nearest provable water; verify the harbour clearance yourself.
route.auto.issueCode.route_geometry_too_: The navigable candidate was too complex to return reliably.
route.auto.issueCode.route_waypoint_limi: The navigable candidate required too many navigation waypoints.
route.auto.issueCode.fine_revalidation_b: Fine-resolution revalidation found land or insufficient depth on the candidate line.
route.auto.apiError.outside_routing_cove: One or both endpoints are outside the Estonia–Finland routing service area.
route.auto.apiError.route_plan_busy: The route planner is busy. Try again shortly.
route.auto.apiError.route_plan_timeout: Route planning exceeded its overall time limit. Try a shorter route.
route.auto.disclaimer: Advisory route only. Before departure, verify the full route, current navigational warnings and water levels against official nautical charts.
route.auto.acceptBeforeNavigation: Accept the route preview before navigation
route.auto.confirmNavigation: The route contains advisory or unknown sections ({distance} NM). Check them against an official nautical chart.
route.auto.confirmNavigationSources: At least one safety source is incomplete or stale. Check the full route against an official nautical chart.
